title: Counit-compatible right-adjoint transport along an equivalence
statement: Let E,J,T be categories, L:E→J an equivalence, P:E→T and Q:J→T functors, ac:P⊣c and ad:Q⊣d adjunctions, and p:L⋙Q≅P. There exists t:c⋙L≅d with Q(t_Z) followed by ad.counit_Z equal to p_{c(Z)} followed by ac.counit_Z for every Z. No assumption on objects or nonemptiness is needed.

source.place: Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR), reduction to ordinary base-change pasting; Remark 20.28.3 (08HY), Remark 20.28.5 (0ATM), and Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S)

proof.text: For e=L.asEquivalence define j:e.inverse⋙P≅Q by whiskering p inverse, re-associating, applying e.counitIso, and the left unitor. Compose e.symm.toAdjunction with ac and transport along j to obtain a:Q⊣c⋙L. Set t=a.rightAdjointUniq ad. Its counit compatibility reduces the desired equation to the formula for a.counit. Expand the transported and composite counits; use naturality of p, functoriality, and e.counitInv_functor_comp to obtain p followed by ac.counit.

proof_origin.note: Split from the ordinary rectangle argument, keeping its geometric construction and adjunction transport separate.

lean.statement:
theorem equivalence_rightAdjoint_counit_transport
    {E J T : Type*} [Category* E] [Category* J] [Category* T]
    (L : E ⥤ J) [L.IsEquivalence]
    {P : E ⥤ T} {Q : J ⥤ T} {c : T ⥤ E} {d : T ⥤ J}
    (ac : P ⊣ c) (ad : Q ⊣ d) (p : L ⋙ Q ≅ P) :
    ∃ t : c ⋙ L ≅ d, ∀ Z : T,
      Q.map (t.hom.app Z) ≫ ad.counit.app Z =
        p.hom.app (c.obj Z) ≫ ac.counit.app Z
